import csv,hashlib,json,os,subprocess
from datetime import datetime,timezone
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(os.environ['EXTERNAL_MET_REMOTE_ROOT']); base=root/'attempts/full103_2025_r1'
model='EXT2025_MET_GLI'; reports=base/'reports'/model
def sha(p):
 h=hashlib.sha256()
 with Path(p).open('rb') as f:
  for block in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(block)
 return h.hexdigest()
assert sha(base/'contract/PACKAGE_SHA256.json')=='4536d7d16462ba784bdd3e8c9b518cc6656755ea53e8e23ef1e648b7f7ff1c44'
contract_sha=sha(base/'contract/EXECUTION_CONTRACT.json')
assert contract_sha=='b6ede31460d7a67c156fb3693f79f6d1c747ffad6f51695e60de35105150c3ff'
for name,digest in json.loads((base/'contract/PACKAGE_SHA256.json').read_text())['files'].items():
 assert sha(base/name)==digest,'frozen package member drift: '+name
assert not (reports/'FAILED.json').exists(),'failed marker conflicts with completion'
items={}
for name in ('STARTED.json','RUN_CONTRACT.json','INPUT_ADAPTER.json','PREDICTION_SHA256.json','COMPLETE.json'):
 p=reports/name; assert p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink() and p.stat().st_size<1048576
 raw=p.read_bytes(); data=json.loads(raw)
 assert data['artifact_status']=='experimental_unvalidated' and data['operator_approved'] is False
 assert data['formal_gate_status']=='not_run_not_passed'
 items[name]=dict(data=data,bytes=len(raw),sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())
complete=items['COMPLETE.json']['data']; manifest=items['PREDICTION_SHA256.json']['data']
assert complete['status']=='full103_inference_outputs_validated_not_scientific_quality_pass'
assert complete['job_id']=='4310575' and complete['cases']==103 and complete['contract_sha256']==contract_sha
assert items['PREDICTION_SHA256.json']['sha256']==complete['prediction_manifest_sha256']
assert manifest['cases']==103 and manifest['contract_sha256']==contract_sha
assert manifest['input_adapter_sha256']==items['INPUT_ADAPTER.json']['sha256']
assert items['STARTED.json']['data']['job_id']=='4310575'
run=items['RUN_CONTRACT.json']['data']
assert run['gpu']['device_count']==1 and 'A100' in run['gpu']['name']
assert run['ground_truth_bound'] is False and run['credentials_bound'] is False and run['network']=='none'
assert complete['reference_labels_read'] is False
adapter=items['INPUT_ADAPTER.json']['data']
assert adapter['input_files']==412 and adapter['labels_read'] is False and adapter['missing_modality_fallback'] is False
csvpath=base/'manifests/FIXED103_REAL_T2W_CASES.csv'
assert sha(csvpath)=='86ba853dadc64ffc45357895ba0bd543bf5b6b14c0c83eb789f1e875d4aa2e7e'
with csvpath.open(newline='') as f: rows=list(csv.DictReader(f))
ids={r['source_case_id'] for r in rows}; assert len(rows)==len(ids)==103 and set(adapter['cases'])==ids
expected={i+'.nii.gz' for i in ids}; destination=base/'predictions'/model
assert set(manifest['files'])==expected and {p.name for p in destination.iterdir()}==expected
total=0
for name,item in manifest['files'].items():
 p=destination/name
 assert p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink() and p.resolve().parent==destination.resolve()
 assert p.stat().st_size==item['bytes'] and sha(p)==item['sha256'],'current prediction identity drift: '+name
 total+=item['bytes']
p=subprocess.run(['sacct','-n','-P','-j','4310575','--format=JobID,State,ExitCode,Elapsed,NodeList,Reason'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=40)
assert p.returncode==0 and len(p.stdout)+len(p.stderr)<65536
records=[line.split('|') for line in p.stdout.splitlines() if line]
for identity in ('4310575','4310575.batch'):
 selected=[r for r in records if r[0]==identity]
 assert len(selected)==1 and selected[0][1:3]==['COMPLETED','0:0'],'successful accounting missing'
print(json.dumps(dict(status='2025_full103_successful_completion_current_prediction_SHA_acceptance',reports=items,
 current_predictions=103,current_prediction_bytes=total,package_sha256=sha(base/'contract/PACKAGE_SHA256.json'),
 contract_sha256=contract_sha,accounting=dict(returncode=p.returncode,stdout=p.stdout,stderr=p.stderr),
 reference_images_or_GT_arrays_read=False,prediction_arrays_read=False,models_loaded=False,
 native_geometry_and_legal_labels_scope='validated_by_frozen_completed_job_not_reloaded_in_this_read_only_acceptance',
 scientific_quality_pass=False,remote_writes=False,jobs_submitted=False,jobs_released=False,automatic_retry=False,
 remote_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat())))
